chapter: Arriving in New York and founding the Afro-Cubans
title: Joining Orquesta Siboney under Alberto Iznaga
summary: After Mario joined Cab Calloway, Machito stayed about a year with La Siboney and recorded with them.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: All right. Mario joined Cab Calloway and then you became part of the same group that was once yours, became La Siboney, under Alberto Iznaga direction. How long did you remain with La Siboney?
Well, it could be a year or so.
Yes, I was the one to talk to the lady to record because I was acquainted with them because I made a lot of recordings with Cuarteto Caney and Noro Morales. We play-------
But you do, you do have recordings with La Siboney?
